system.description:
You manifest a beast made of crystal. By molding your crystal release chakra, you are able to conjure a crystal Deer. Crystal Deer are Earthen Artifacts.

The Crystal Deer has the listed statistics found at the end of this clan on its stat block. It uses your highest jutsu attack bonus or Save DC when an effect calls for it and you command it as a Bonus action.

| Crystallization / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental], [Physical] / A Crystallized creature suffers the effects of their body and chakra network being slowly transfigured into crystal. / A Crystallized creature increases the base chakra cost of Jutsu they cast by +4, for each rank it has. / A creature with 3 or more ranks of Crystallization has its movement speed reduced by half, and they cannot gain bonuses to their speed for the duration of this condition. / A creature with 5 ranks of Crystallization are Petrified for the next hour. If a creature with 5 ranks of Crystallization take damage from a Jutsu based attack, they are treated as vulnerable to the triggering damage, instead of resistant. This condition then ends. / Creatures that are immune to being Petrified is immune to this condition. / A Crystallized creature can spend an Action, even if Petrified to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

If you have the Crystal Deer and other creatures summoned by Shoton Hijutsu, you can command them all separately, as part of the same Bonus action used to command the Crystal Deer.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the Deer’s hit points by 15.
